chunks: From him, from ʿAlī, from his father, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Zayd al-Shaḥḥām, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:
A man became confused and did not know whether he had performed one sajdah or two. He said: Then let him perform another one.
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he doubts whether he performed one sajdah or two in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who doubts during salat whether he performed one sajdah or two. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to perform one additional sajdah, indicating how such uncertainty is remedied in worship.
